name: Goblin Engineering

angles.text: Goblin engineering is one of the two major specialized traditions open to master engineers. It focuses on volatile munitions, heavy explosive yield, and catastrophic destruction.
Engineers who pursue goblin craft rely heavily on refined ores, blasting powders, and solid stones to make incendiaries and bombs.

faq.answer: Goblin Engineering is a discipline devoted to high-yield explosions. Its practitioners craft powerful explosives, bombs, and heavy destructive devices instead of the intricate gadgets favored by gnomish engineers.

Gnomish engineering favors strange utility devices, complex tinkering, and inventive gadgets. Goblin engineering puts firepower, blasting powders, and destructive yield first. Goblin inventions are aggressive and effective, though hazardous to handle.
faq.q: How does goblin engineering differ from gnomish engineering?

faq.answer: Master goblin engineers teach the discipline to recruits willing to work with explosions and blasting powder. Master Engineer Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan is a prominent trainer who tests candidates before teaching them the trade.
faq.q: Who teaches the goblin engineering discipline?

faq.answer: Goblin inventors accept danger as part of the craft. Their designs maximize explosive output and concussive force, bringing unpredictable malfunctions, sudden detonations, and personal risk to the artisan handling them.
faq.q: Is goblin engineering dangerous to practice?

faq.answer: Engineers of both the Alliance and Horde can learn goblin engineering once they are sufficiently skilled. Goblin tinkerers work mainly through neutral cartels such as the Steamwheedle Cartel, which welcomes anyone with steady hands, enough coin, and a love of explosive force.
faq.q: Can both factions learn goblin engineering?

faq.answer: Engineers choose goblin engineering for its unmatched destructive capability. It produces lethal combat explosives, mortar guns, land mines, and portable rockets made to obliterate opposition on the battlefield.
faq.q: Why would an engineer choose the goblin discipline?

sections.body: Azeroth's engineers follow two distinct philosophies. Goblin tinkerers favor violent combustion, while other inventors make delicate clockwork and subtle devices. Goblins harness blasting powder to build tools of great devastation, turning fire, shrapnel, and concussive force toward practical problems.
sections.title: The Art of the Detonation

sections.body: Goblin engineers make no secret of the hazards. Recruits work with volatile compounds, heavy incendiaries, and prototypes that may singe their creator's eyebrows or level an opposing barricade. They prize maximum yield and destructive power, and welcome engineers who choose decisive firepower over fragile safety rules.
sections.title: Volatility and Power

summary: Among master inventors, Goblin Engineering offers a path to command explosive power and volatile concussive ordnance. Its craft relies on high-yield blasting powders and relentless firepower, making it a destructive choice beside intricate tinkering.
